graph.thresholding: percentile on upper-triangle absolute FC values
graph.edge_selection_rule: abs_fc >= threshold (nominal 15% density; ties may produce more edges)
graph.edge_weights: signed FC (retained as edge_attr; not passed as edge weights to GCNConv layers)
graph.node_features: 117 (116 signed FC values + normalized degree: np.sum(abs_fc >= threshold, axis=1) / 116)

training.split_provenance: stratified train/test (0.20) and train/val (0.20) with random_state=42
training.deterministic_reproducibility: Random state 42 was used for clean split; full deterministic training reproducibility was not established

quantum.input_encoding: RY + RZ angle encoding (after 117 -> 12 classical projection)
quantum.trainable_circuit: trainable RX, RY, RZ rotations followed by ring CNOT entanglement
